assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original local background for a Chinese tabletop game waiting or recovery screen, landscape 16:9. Bright friendly board-game-console visual style: gouache illustration, rounded wooden-toy shapes, very restrained paper grain and soft dimensional shadows. Warm cream #F6F2E8, teal #247C75, golden #F4BE45, coral #E77A60. Central 70 percent and upper middle remain clean light cream negative space for interface copy added by code later. Environment only; no people, no characters, no animals, no cards, no dice, no coins, no scores, no game board, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no UI controls. Opaque background.
